DeterminationBasis: Existing T13 controls preserve known failures and deviation records, and T13-008 requires material deviations to enter the conformance evidence package, but no existing T13 control enforces the complete DEV-002 deviation-record field set: affected requirement, reason, affected scope, approving authority where applicable, effective period where time-bounded, expected consequence, and residual claim limitation. A dedicated deviation-record completeness control is therefore required.

Existing T14 controls preserve frozen predecessors, create successor artifacts and classify post-freeze corrections, but none requires a previous conformance claim to remain explicitly bounded to the exact standard version under which that claim was established when a normative change alters conformance requirements. A dedicated historical-claim version-binding control is therefore required.
